package.name: multi_goal_to_gp_goal
package.description:
Bridge msg_set_msgs/MultiGoal (from execute_task_server on /waypoint_goals) to sensor_msgs/NavSatFix (on /gp_goal for nav2_input_bridge).
Subscribes to /waypoint_goals, forwards the first GPS waypoint to /gp_goal so that the existing nav2_input_bridge -> straight_planner -> controller_server pipeline accepts it. Local-frame waypoints (is_gps_aid=false) are skipped with a warning since they cannot be expressed as a NavSatFix.
